ambiguities.description: The finalization artifacts require the exact blocker scientific decision required and do not authorize executable scientific semantics.
ambiguities.preservation: Packages are structural_only, retain the blocker in unresolved output, and reject scientific evaluation.

ambiguities.description: Ownership mechanism, allocation, layout, aliasing, serialization, concurrency, and copy/move details are not scientifically or contractually fixed.
ambiguities.preservation: The final runtime contracts constrain immutability, input-change invisibility, and no observable partial result only; remaining details are implementation-defined or unconstrained.

ambiguities.description: Algorithm files present total step lists, but the sources do not establish every internal ordering edge as observable behavior.
ambiguities.preservation: Final strategy contracts are partially_constrained and retain only validation, preservation, blocker, construction, and publication dependencies justified by observable behavior.

ambiguities.description: Error transport and language-level mechanism are not specified.
ambiguities.preservation: Authoritative error identifiers and failure conditions are normative; transport remains implementation_defined and failures expose no partial result.

ambiguities.description: Object-map and ordered-symbolic envelopes recur across features, but resemblance does not prove scientific equivalence.
ambiguities.preservation: Two candidate-only structures are recorded without changing handoff/shared or merging feature semantics.

ambiguities.description: The authoritative inventory count uses expected_active_count, while the current compatibility validator recognizes feature_count, population_count, active_feature_count, or summary.active_features.
ambiguities.preservation: The discrepancy is not scientific. CI will establish whether a minimal count-key compatibility normalization is required; no count or feature population will be changed.
